description: Composite texture figure for an Fe–8% Al ferritic alloy deformed by torsion: one schematic orientation map plus four measured pole figures. (a) is a stereographic {110} pole figure (rotational axis labelled Z vertically, θ horizontally) marking ideal bcc torsion orientations with symbols, with arrowed annotations "{110}<uvw> fibre" and "{hkl}<111> fibre"; its legend defines D1 △{11̄2}<111>, D2 □{1̄12}<111>, E1 ▽{01̄1}<111>, E2 ○{01̄1}<111>, F ◇{110}<001>, J1 ×{01̄1}<2̄11> and J2 +{1̄10}<1̄1̄2>, with J1, J2, E1, E2, D1, D2 plotted at several positions around the circle. (b)–(e) are circular (110) contour pole figures of the torsion-deformed alloy at increasing strain, each printed with a maximum intensity value: (b) ε = 2, max 2.50; (c) ε = 5, max 2.46; (d) ε = 15, max 3.43; (e) ε = 25, max 3.17. The group argues that the torsion texture develops toward the ideal torsion components of (a), with contour density and the printed maximum reaching their highest value in (d) at ε = 15 and decreasing slightly in (e) at ε = 25, while a concentric central peak appears in (c)–(e). No contour levels or axes scales are printed on (b)–(e).
measured_quantities: texture maximum intensity ('max', multiples of random)

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a labelled stereographic {110} pole figure with the axis Z at the top and θ at the right, annotated with arrowed '{110}<uvw> fibre' and '{hkl}<111> fibre' text.
The caption states that (a) is a {110} pole figure displaying ideal orientations observed during a torsion test for a bcc alloy [11].
The caption titles the figure '{110} pole figures of the Fe–8% Al alloy deformed by torsion'.
The citing text states that Figure 3 displays {110} pole figures of the Fe–8% Al ferritic alloy deformed by torsion, that the shear plane normal is {hkl} and the shear direction is <uvw>.
Panels (b)–(e) are circular (110) pole figures drawn as contour lines, without printed axis ticks, angular scales or contour-level values.
Printed maximum intensity values are 2.50 for (b) ε = 2, 2.46 for (c) ε = 5, 3.43 for (d) ε = 15 and 3.17 for (e) ε = 25.
The printed texture maximum is lowest for (c) at ε = 5 (2.46) and highest for (d) at ε = 15 (3.43), so the maximum does not increase monotonically with strain.
A small concentric ring of contours near the centre of the pole figure is present in (c), (d) and (e).

Panel (a) marks the same seven orientation symbols (J2, J1, E1, E2, D1, D2, F) repeated at multiple locations around the pole figure, indicating the symmetry-equivalent positions of each ideal component.

subfigures.description: Schematic stereographic {110} pole figure of ideal torsion orientations in a bcc alloy, axes Z (vertical) and θ (horizontal), annotated '{110}<uvw> fibre' and '{hkl}<111> fibre', with a symbol legend defining D1 △{11̄2}<111>, D2 □{1̄12}<111>, E1 ▽{01̄1}<111>, E2 ○{01̄1}<111>, F ◇{110}<001>, J1 ×{01̄1}<2̄11> and J2 +{1̄10}<1̄1̄2>.
Circular (110) contour pole figure of the Fe–8% Al alloy after torsion to ε = 2, labelled '(110)', printed max : 2.50; contour regions are distributed broadly with resolved local maxima.
Circular (110) contour pole figure at ε = 5, printed max : 2.46; contours are weaker and more diffuse, with a small concentric ring near the centre.
Circular (110) contour pole figure at ε = 15, printed max : 3.43 (highest of the series); the strongest, most clustered contours of the four panels plus a central concentric peak.
Circular (110) contour pole figure at ε = 25, printed max : 3.17; strong contours with a concentric central spot and a band of high density along a near-vertical line.

unreadable_items: panel (a): the exact negative-index digits in the D2 and J2 orientation labels are only partially legible at the supplied resolution
panels (b)–(e): no contour-level values or axis scale are printed, so contour densities cannot be read quantitatively beyond the stated 'max' number
